 WHEELING, W.Va. — Teachers and students from 10 local schools gathered Tuesday morning as Main Street Bank announced the winners of its annual holiday billboard contest.
 Each school had a selected winner. The winning schools’ art programs will receive a $500 check and a keepsake trophy.
 “I think the schools do a really good job of promoting this, and I think the kids have heard about it throughout the years,” said Donnie Sheller, executive vice president and chief operating officer of Main Street Bank. “They get really excited about it and do a great job putting together some masterful artwork, which makes for a great time during the selection committee process.”
 The selection committee said it was difficult to judge so many strong art pieces and noted the enjoyment of community involvement with students at a young age.
